decisions.w6_gap: Build W5 bilingual and staged. Both locales' prompt text lives in W5-owned files; window phrases / a11y labels / month names live in a W5-local src/lib/memory/copy.ts staging post, the same pattern W3 used for src/app/onboarding/copy.ts. Side prompts carry their own format rules rather than forking base.ts, which is W6's file. English is unreachable at runtime until W6 flips users.locale.
decisions.week_start: Monday (ISO-8601). Plan open question 1, settled with Miftah 2026-07-27.
decisions.birthday_window: Collapses to [today, today] on the birthday itself; the gate hides it. Plan open question 2, settled with Miftah 2026-07-27.
decisions.cross_reader_recall: Left as M12 specifies: on by default, with the reader named in the block. Plan open question 5 stays open pending one real read on hardware.
